# Coleman Lai

Personal site of Coleman Lai, a high-achieving computing science student at Simon Fraser University and an origami artist in Vancouver. The site is a gallery of software projects and folded paper models.

## Pages
    
- [Home](https://www.colemanlai.com/): introduction, contact, and featured work
- [Portfolio](https://www.colemanlai.com/portfolio): software projects
- [Origami](https://www.colemanlai.com/origami): original designs and models folded from other designers
- [Sitemap](https://www.colemanlai.com/sitemap.xml): every public page
